description:
Technical Skill :- 
 Should have knowledge MapR Hadoop distribution (MapR is different than  

 Mapreduce. MapR is a Hadoop distribution) 
 Should have expertise in Java
 Should have coded Hive programs and used HiveQL extensively
 Should have coded Pig programs and used Pig commands (not just UDFs in Pig)
 Should have experience in installing and configuring Hadoop components like Hive, Pig, Hbase, etc. independently
 Coding experience in HBASE API in loading and extracting from Hbase
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 12+ Months 
 Candidate must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
